Package de.labathome.trustconstr

Class VectorFunction

java.lang.Object
de.labathome.trustconstr.VectorFunction
All Implemented Interfaces:
VectorFunctionLike
public class VectorFunction extends Object implements VectorFunctionLike
Vector function and its derivatives. This class defines a vector function F: R^n->R^m and methods for computing or approximating its first and second derivatives. Notes ----- This class implements a memoization logic. There are methods `fun`, `jac`, hess` and corresponding attributes `f`, `J` and `H`. The following things should be considered: 1. Use only public methods `fun`, `jac` and `hess`. 2. After one of the methods is called, the corresponding attribute will be set. However, a subsequent call with a different argument of *any* of the methods may overwrite the attribute.
